plain_statement: It is false that: Let G have an edge, no cycle shorter than 7, A a set of vertices met by no edge, every vertex outside A with exactly 3 neighbours, and k at most the size of every vertex cover. Let F be true when a variable of A is true or both ends of an edge are true. Every circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two computing F has at least |A| + |E| + k - 1 gates.
